name: warming up in lunge (five)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 5: rotate the chest and reach one arm upward from a hands-supported runner's lunge.
instructions: Enter a runner's lunge with the rear leg extended and one hand planted near the front foot.
Keep your hips low and rotate your chest toward the front-leg side.
Reach the free arm toward the ceiling, following the hand with your eyes if comfortable.
Return the hand to the floor, then switch legs and repeat.
